messages:
lucy: quick note — when running the dev stack I saw real-looking emails in the app logs at DEBUG level. happened during the onboarding flow, might surface in demos. anyone else hit this?
dan: yep, that's the autoinit + OTEL ordering issue: SDK instruments early and captures structured attrs before our express redactor runs.
pete: can you paste the raw line?
lucy: sure: `2026-06-21T14:12:01.457Z DEBUG request_id=rd-900 user.email=dev.user@realmail.com route=/signup`
dan: reproducible? steps?
lucy: git clone sampleapp, cp .env.example (LOG_LEVEL=debug), npm ci, npm run dev, hit /signup with samples/seed.json. grep logs for "@realmail.com"
dan: short fixes: set LOG_LEVEL=info in onboarding, scrub seed emails to example.invalid, or disable autoinit in quickstart (AUTOINIT=false). medium fix: register a pre-export OTEL LogProcessor that redacts emails when AUTOINIT=true. long term: SDK should include a built-in redaction processor for dev mode.
telemetry-bot: Created ticket INF-2045: "devstack: PII in logs due to autoinit ordering" 702a35 https://tracker.internal/INF-2045 :bug:
lucy: I'll open a small PR to 1) change onboarding default LOG_LEVEL to info, 2) scrub seeds to example.invalid, and 3) add a note in docs/quickstart.md about AUTOINIT env opt. Assigning to myself.
dan: thanks — when you PR please add a tiny CI grep step to catch email regex in onboarding logs. pete: can you draft the SDK RFC about bundling a dev-mode redaction processor?
pete: on it. will post a short proposal later today. :thumbsup:
